articleTitle: What to Do After a Blackout You Can't Remember Consenting To
imageHeadline: Woke up with no memory of last night?
imageSubtext: What a blackout means for consent and what to do now
pinTitle: What to Do After a Blackout You Can't Remember Consenting To | Mindtivate
pinDescription: If you've woken up with no memory of the night before, you're facing urgent questions about consent, safety, and next steps. This guide walks through what alcohol blackouts mean, why memory loss complicates consent, and the practical actions you can take now—from medical care to support resources.
